title: Chapter 400: Dragon'S Tail Vs Dragon Flying In The Sky
content:
Chapter 400: Dragon'S Tail Vs Dragon Flying In The Sky

Zhu Dongheng was forced back by the Black Dragon King, and Wang Shuo took over Zhu Dongheng's position.

But when he really fought with the Black Dragon King, he knew why Zhao Bangde was so cautious.

Seeing Wang Shuo's aura of a high-level warrior, the Black Dragon King was also a little dignified.

He didn't expect that this kid was promoted to two major levels in a row.

This was a situation he had never seen before, and it confused the Black Dragon King.

Facing Wang Shuo, the Black Dragon King became cautious.

"Boy, remember that a few months ago, it was you who released me personally. I haven't had time to thank you yet!"

The Black Dragon King hovered in the air and rarely chatted with family.

In fact, he was observing Wang Shuo's strength.

The aura exuded by Wang Shuo now exceeded him, so he was thinking whether to fight, or persuade Wang Shuo to join him.

"You are Wang Shuo, right? I remember you. If you can join the undead, I can guarantee that your power is only below mine."

Wang Shuo was also a little nervous. He was just strong on the outside but weak on the inside.

It was impossible to surrender, but at this time, he had not thought about how to fight.

He had just broken through, and he did not have a clear understanding of his own strength.

If he acted rashly, he was afraid of exposing his true strength and causing the Black Dragon King to attack with all his strength.

Wang Shuo was also in a dilemma.

"Black Dragon King, it is impossible to surrender to you. If you can retreat today, we can still maintain peace. Otherwise... I can kill you once, and I can kill you a second time."

Wang Shuo's tone was firm and there was no need to argue.

Both of them felt a little empty in their hearts, and they were not sure how strong the other party was.

But if they retreated at this point, would the Black Dragon King not have face?

So, the Black Dragon King laughed strangely.

"Okay, in this case, if you can take my attack, today's battle will end here!"

Being able to avoid fighting naturally meets the wishes of many people.

But some sober-minded generals knew that this was just a stopgap measure, and the two sides must fight.

Wang Shuo is now in a dilemma.

He knew very well that if he took the attack from the Black Dragon King, his true strength would be exposed. However, showing his weakness would not only chill the hearts of the human soldiers, but also strengthen the Black Dragon King's determination to destroy the human race immediately.

Wang Shuo's face sank, and he slowly said: "Black Dragon King, then make a move. It happens that I have just broken through, and I also want to see how strong I am."

Wang Shuo had to agree to the Black Dragon King's request.

In mid-air, the Black Dragon King condensed the death energy, and the momentum around him burst out. It was obvious that he was brewing a big move.

Wang Shuo also held his breath and concentrated his strength, intending to use his strongest killing move.

"The dragon swings its tail."

"The flying dragon is in the sky."

In mid-air, the Black Dragon King twisted his huge body, swung his tail, and performed a move of "dragon swinging its tail".

Wang Shuo also mobilized his internal strength, and the Overlord Spear was tilted at a 45-degree angle, stabbing the Black Dragon King in mid-air.

The giant dragon phantom, which was also a black dragon, rushed straight into the sky and collided with the dragon tail of the Black Dragon King.

"Boom..."

The huge explosion, accompanied by dazzling light, stung the soldiers' eyes.

Only those above the top military commander level could barely open their eyes and look at the explosion in front of them.

Wang Shuo was pushed back several steps by the huge air wave. He felt sweet in his mouth and his blood surged, but he held it back.

But, his breath was unstable just now, and for a moment, his momentum fell to the level of a mid-level general.

The Black Dragon King keenly captured this point.

If Wang Shuo was replaced by Zhao Bangde, the Black Dragon King would definitely think that this old bastard must be showing weakness to the enemy.

But this is Wang Shuo, he has always been cautious.

This time, the breath was unstable, and it must be true.
